name: audio_pitch_harmonics
expr: f220 = pitch(x220, fs); f100 = pitch(x100, fs); h220 = harmonicRatio(x220, fs); pn220 = numel(f220); hn220 = numel(h220); f220_first = f220(1); f220_mean = mean(f220); f100_mean = mean(f100); h220_mean = mean(h220); fcep220 = pitch(x220, fs, 'Method', 'CEP'); cep_first = fcep220(1); cep_2 = fcep220(2); cep_4 = fcep220(4); cep_mean = mean(fcep220); fpef220 = pitch(x220, fs, 'Method', 'PEF'); pef_first = fpef220(1); pef_mean = mean(fpef220);
comment: MATLAB Audio Toolbox cycles E + F + K + K-2: pitch + harmonicRatio. pitch via NCF (Normalized Cross-correlation Function) — default method per MATLAB R2025b. Defaults match MATLAB: WindowLength=round(0.052*fs)=832 samples for fs=16000, OverlapLength=round(0.042*fs)=672, hop=160, Range=[50,400] Hz. harmonicRatio uses 30/20ms windows. Frame counts (95 for pitch, 98 for harmonicRatio at 16001 samples) match MATLAB exactly. f0 NCF within ~1% of true frequency. Cycle F: harmonicRatio gained MATLAB R2025b parity (auto low-edge + Smith parabolic refinement). Cycle K: Method='CEP' (Cepstrum, Noll 1967) — bit-equal via batched FFT. Cycle K-2: Method='PEF' (Pitch Estimation Filter, Gonzalez & Brookes 2011) — bit-equal MATLAB R2025b audio.internal.pitch.PEF.m. Pipeline: log-spaced frequency grid (NFFT points from 10 Hz to min(fs/2-1,4000)), interp1 power spectrum onto log grid, FFT-based cross-correlation with PEF filter (h = 1/(γ - cos(2π q)) - β where q = logspace(log10(0.5), log10(K+0.5), NFFT/2)), peak picking → f0 = logSF(peak). All FFT sizes used by PEF/CEP are power-of-2 by construction. KNOWN GAPs: 'LHS'/'SRH' still deferred (use fftLength=round(fs) which is non-power-of-2 typically — blocked on libs/signal::fft fix); pitchnn deferred (needs DNN runtime). Tolerance 5% for parity (algorithmic equivalence rather than bit-equality for NCF; CEP and PEF are bit-equal).
